name: reso
label: RESO (Real Estate)
description: Real Estate Standards Organization — MLS/IDX standard for North America

table_notes.reso_property: Core listing record per RESO Data Dictionary 2.0; one row per MLS listing, keyed by listing_key. The features JSONB column holds additional amenity and attribute data not covered by scalar columns.
table_notes.reso_media: Photos, virtual tours, and documents attached to a listing. The is_preferred flag marks the primary display image; order controls carousel sort.
table_notes.reso_member: Licensed real estate agents and brokers registered in the MLS. member_license_number is issued by the state licensing authority.
table_notes.reso_office: Brokerage office records. Agents (reso_member) are implicitly affiliated with an office via the MLS feed; add an office_key FK to reso_member if your MLS supplies it.
table_notes.reso_open_house: Scheduled public or broker open house events for a listing. Multiple events per listing are allowed; each has its own date and time window.

reso_property.name: listing_key
reso_property.description: MLS system-assigned unique key for this listing (RESO standard primary identifier)

reso_property.name: listing_id
reso_property.description: Human-readable MLS listing number displayed to agents and consumers

reso_property.name: status
reso_property.description: Local MLS status label (varies by board); use standard_status for cross-MLS portability

reso_property.name: standard_status
reso_property.description: RESO-standardised status: Active, Pending, Closed, Expired, Withdrawn, Cancelled, ActiveUnderContract

reso_property.name: property_type
reso_property.description: RESO property type: Residential, CommercialSale, CommercialLease, Land, MultiFamily, etc.

reso_property.name: property_subtype
reso_property.description: More granular classification within property_type (e.g. SingleFamilyResidence, Condominium)

reso_property.name: street_number
reso_property.description: Civic street number portion of the property address

reso_property.name: street_name
reso_property.description: Street name portion of the property address (excluding number and suffix)

reso_property.name: city
reso_property.description: City or municipality where the property is located

reso_property.name: state_or_province
reso_property.description: State or province abbreviation (e.g. CA, ON) per the RESO State/Province lookup

reso_property.name: postal_code
reso_property.description: ZIP or postal code for the property address

reso_property.name: country
reso_property.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. US, CA)

reso_property.name: latitude
reso_property.description: WGS84 latitude of the property in decimal degrees

reso_property.name: longitude
reso_property.description: WGS84 longitude of the property in decimal degrees

reso_property.name: list_price
reso_property.description: Current asking price in the local currency at time of listing

reso_property.name: close_price
reso_property.description: Final sale price recorded at closing; NULL until the transaction closes

reso_property.name: list_date
reso_property.description: Date the property was first made active on the MLS

reso_property.name: close_date
reso_property.description: Date the sale was legally closed and title transferred; NULL until closed

reso_property.name: days_on_market
reso_property.description: Number of calendar days the listing has been or was active on the MLS

reso_property.name: bedrooms_total
reso_property.description: Total number of bedrooms across all levels of the property

reso_property.name: bathrooms_total_decimal
reso_property.description: Total bathrooms as decimal (full bath=1.0, half bath=0.5) per RESO convention

reso_property.name: living_area
reso_property.description: Above-grade finished living area in square feet (RESO living_area_units for metric)

reso_property.name: lot_size_acres
reso_property.description: Lot or parcel size in acres; convert to sq ft (*43560) or hectares (*0.4047) as needed

reso_property.name: year_built
reso_property.description: Year the primary structure was originally constructed (4-digit year)

reso_property.name: public_remarks
reso_property.description: Agent-authored marketing description shown to consumers on IDX/portal sites

reso_property.name: features
reso_property.description: JSONB bag of supplemental RESO fields; expected keys: appliances[], heating[], cooling[], parking[], amenities[]

reso_media.name: media_key
reso_media.description: MLS system-assigned unique key for this media asset

reso_media.name: listing_key
reso_media.description: References reso_property.listing_key; the listing this media asset belongs to

reso_media.name: media_url
reso_media.description: Publicly accessible URL to the full-resolution media asset

reso_media.name: media_type
reso_media.description: RESO media type: Photo, Video, VirtualTour, FloorPlan, Document, ExteriorMap, etc.

reso_media.name: sort_order
reso_media.description: Display sort order; lower values appear first in photo carousels

reso_media.name: is_preferred
reso_media.description: True for the primary/hero image to display as the listing thumbnail

reso_media.name: caption
reso_media.description: Agent-supplied caption or alt-text for the media asset

reso_member.name: member_key
reso_member.description: MLS system-assigned unique key for this agent/broker member

reso_member.name: member_mls_id
reso_member.description: Human-readable MLS member ID displayed on listings and business cards

reso_member.name: member_email
reso_member.description: Primary contact email; must be unique per RFC 5321 address spec (max 320 chars)

reso_member.name: member_direct_phone
reso_member.description: Member's direct contact phone number in E.164 or local format

reso_member.name: member_license_number
reso_member.description: State/provincial real estate license number issued by the regulatory authority

reso_member.name: member_status
reso_member.description: RESO member status: Active, Inactive, Pending, Suspended; controls MLS access rights

reso_office.name: office_key
reso_office.description: MLS system-assigned unique key for this brokerage office

reso_office.name: office_mls_id
reso_office.description: Human-readable MLS office ID used on listings and regulatory filings

reso_office.name: office_name
reso_office.description: Legal or trade name of the brokerage office

reso_office.name: office_phone
reso_office.description: Main reception phone number for the office

reso_office.name: office_address
reso_office.description: Full civic address of the office (street number, name, suite)

reso_office.name: office_city
reso_office.description: City where the brokerage office is physically located

reso_office.name: office_postal_code
reso_office.description: ZIP or postal code of the office address

reso_open_house.name: open_house_key
reso_open_house.description: MLS system-assigned unique key for this open house event

reso_open_house.name: listing_key
reso_open_house.description: References reso_property.listing_key; the listing being shown at this open house

reso_open_house.name: open_house_date
reso_open_house.description: Calendar date on which the open house is scheduled

reso_open_house.name: open_house_start_time
reso_open_house.description: Local start time for public admission to the open house

reso_open_house.name: open_house_end_time
reso_open_house.description: Local end time; visitors are expected to leave by this time

reso_open_house.name: open_house_type
reso_open_house.description: RESO open house type: Public, BrokerOnly, Private, Twilight, Virtual

reso_open_house.name: remarks
reso_open_house.description: Agent notes for the open house (directions, parking instructions, highlights)

short_description: Real Estate Standards Organization — MLS/IDX standard for North America
long_description: RESO (Real Estate Standards Organization) defines the data dictionary used by all Multiple Listing Services (MLS) in North America. The schema includes the core property listing fields (status, price, features), media assets, agent/member details, brokerage office data, and open house records — all aligned with RESO Data Dictionary 2.0.
when_to_use: Use for real estate portals, MLS applications, property management systems, or any real estate API integration. IDX (Internet Data Exchange) compliance is legally required by NAR rules for all MLS participants. The RESO API standard is used by Zillow, Realtor.com, and all major US/Canadian real estate platforms.
